diagram.manim_description: On a plain white BG canvas (16:9) draw the finished paper construction of a right triangle. All coordinates are figure units (1 unit = 1 cm); scale them by one common factor so the whole drawing, labels included, is centred with an even margin. Draw the side of length 8 as a vertical INK line (3 px) from (0, 0) up to (0, 8). Draw the right angle at (0, 0) as a horizontal INK line (3 px) from (0, 0) to (15, 0), and continue it as a thin GUIDE line from (15, 0) to (16.3, 0). Draw a small INK right-angle square at (0, 0) with corners (0, 0), (0.9, 0), (0.9, 0.9), (0, 0.9). Draw the hypotenuse as an INK line (3 px) from (0, 8) to (15, 0); its length is 17. Draw the compass arc in GUIDE (2 px) with centre (0, 8) and radius 17, running from angle -36 degrees to angle -20 degrees measured at the centre from the positive x direction, so that it passes exactly through (15, 0). Write 8 cm in INK centred at (-1.9, 4.0), to the left of the vertical side. Write 15 cm in ANSWER green centred at (7.5, -1.2), below the horizontal side. Write 17 cm in INK centred at (8.206, 5.324), above and to the right of the hypotenuse. Draw no vertex letters and no other text.
accuracy_checks: 8^2 + 15^2 = 64 + 225 = 289 = 17^2, so the three lengths 8, 15, 17 fit one right triangle
the arc has centre (0, 8) and radius 17 and passes through (15, 0): 15^2 + 8^2 = 289
the vertical side and the horizontal side meet at (0, 0) at a right angle
the drawing is to scale: the horizontal side is 15/8 times the vertical side and the hypotenuse is 17/8 times it
diagram.alt_text: A right triangle with a vertical side of 8 cm, a horizontal side of 15 cm and a slanting side of 17 cm, with the compass arc of radius 17 cm centred at the top of the vertical side crossing the horizontal line.
diagram.render_note: No book picture exists for this question (page 15 has none). Drawn from the LP solution step 1. Orientation (8 cm side vertical, 15 cm side horizontal) is chosen only so that the construction fits a 16:9 card.
